statements.impact_statement: The renderer at element-view.tsx:293 injects element.textContent via dangerouslySetInnerHTML for TEXT lesson elements. That field is written only through CurriculumService.createElement / updateElement (backend/src/services/curriculum-service/curriculum-service.ts:1107,1187), both of which pass textContent through sanitizeRichText — a sanitize-html allowlist (backend/src/config/rich-text.ts:50-85) that drops script/iframe/event-handlers/javascript: URLs and restricts style to a fixed property set. No other write path reaches the textContent column (grep of backend/src for CurriculumGateway.createElement/updateElement returns only the service). Sanitization has dedicated unit tests in backend/tests/unit/rich-text.test.ts.
